question_cn: 开局出子的正确顺序是什么？
question_en: What is the correct order for developing in the opening?

options.text_cn: 先出后，再出马和象，最后易位
options.text_en: Develop the queen first, then knights and bishops, and castle last.

options.text_cn: 先出马和象（轻子），易位激活车，后在合适时机出动
options.text_en: Develop knights and bishops, castle to activate a rook, then bring out the queen when appropriate.

options.text_cn: 先推兵把线路全部打开，再出所有棋子
options.text_en: Advance pawns to open every line before developing any pieces.

options.text_cn: 顺序无所谓，只要棋子出来就行
options.text_en: The order does not matter as long as the pieces are developed.

explanation_cn: 开局的标准出子顺序：① 推中心兵（开线路）→ ② 出马和象（轻子，快速出子）→ ③ 易位（王安全，激活车）→ ④ 后在合适时机出动。后过早出动会被对方轻子追着跑，每被追一次就损失一步先手。车需要通过易位才能进入主要线路。
explanation_en: A standard sequence is: advance a central pawn to open lines, develop knights and bishops, castle to secure the king and activate a rook, then develop the queen when appropriate. Bringing the queen out too early lets minor pieces attack it and costs time. Castling helps connect the rooks and bring them into play.
